topic: Prompt of the week: write a job description for your AI agent
post:
AI agents now work while you sleep. 🌙
So they need what every new hire needs: a clear job description.

This week OpenAI launched "dots," always-on agents you can assign ongoing work to. They run in the background, connect to apps like Slack and Teams, and keep going without you watching.

That's powerful. It also means vague instructions get expensive.

So here's my prompt of the week, the Agent Job Description.
Use it with any AI agent, from any company 👇

"Your role: [what you're responsible for]
Your goal: [what 'done' looks like]
You may: [actions you're allowed to take]
Ask me first before: sending, deleting, spending, or sharing anything
Report back: a short summary every [day/week], including anything you weren't sure about."

Why it matters:
The difference between a helpful agent and a risky one is often the instructions. Clear limits plus regular check-ins keep you in control.

Practical takeaway:
Before you turn on any always-on agent, fill in those 5 lines. If you can't, the task isn't ready to hand off yet.

What's the first job you'd give an always-on AI agent? 👇

Follow for daily AI news.
